source: The official Barbados portal, Immigration Department visitor page and Form E.1 specification were read on 2026-08-30. They publish required information groups but the protected live application exposes no readable regexes, maxlengths or validation messages. No hidden pattern is claimed.

flight_information.label: Flight or vessel information
flight_information.help: Use the operating arrival flight or vessel information for this trip.

passport.label: Passenger passport
passport.help: Use the passport carried to Barbados. It must be valid for the duration of the trip.

full_name.label: Name as shown in travel document
full_name.help: Copy last name and given names from the travel document.

date_of_birth.label: Date of birth
date_of_birth.help: Match the travel document. Follow the date control shown by the current form.

intended_address.label: Intended address in Barbados
intended_address.help: Use the confirmed hotel, accommodation or host address for this stay.

length_of_stay.label: Length of stay
length_of_stay.help: Enter the planned number of nights for the current visit.

customs_declaration.label: Customs declaration
customs_declaration.help: Answer the Customs section for all goods and values carried.

email.label: Email address
email.help: The separate Immigration and Customs receipts are emailed to this address.
